evidence: Has Wallet label and modifies wallet descriptor extraction and PSBT creation in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp and src/script/descriptor.cpp.
rationale: External signers like BitBox02 refuse to sign multisig transactions when Bitcoin Core omits PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB fields. Fixing this resolves an interoperability failure (issue #27583) preventing multisig users from completing transactions with stateless hardware signers.
